Title: LLMs Used in the Design Assistance Study  
Claim: The study evaluated four state‑of‑the‑art large language models—ChatGPT 4o, DeepSeek R1, Claude 3.7, and Gemini 2.5 Pro—as design assistants for software architecture decisions.  
Evidence: "The LLMs chosen were: • ChatGPT 4o • DeepSeek R1 • Claude 3.7 • Gemini 2.5 Pro"  
Labels: LLM selection, Design assistance  
Conditions: The selection was made for the 2025 workshop experiment  
Limits: Only these four models were evaluated; no other LLMs were included

Title: Experience Profile of Workshop Participants  
Claim: In the 2025 workshop, 23 participants—industry professionals, academic researchers, and graduate students—had substantial experience, with nearly 75% having over five years of software development experience and over 60% having equivalent experience in software architecture and design.  
Evidence: "Nearly 75% had more than five years of software development experience, and over 60% had equivalent experience in software architecture and design."  
Labels: Participant demographics, Experience  
Conditions: Based on the 23 workshop attendees  
Limits: No data on participants outside this group
